The '''Forlonis Minor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the astronomical object [[Forlonis Minor]].<ref name="HONSBS" />
